name: integrations-hero
title: Integrations Hero
description: A hero showing the stack Mirro is built on, with animated flowing lines converging on a center node.
accessibility: The flowing lines and convergence are decorative. Icon tiles expose their label via title for screen readers.
touch: The flowing line animation is CSS/transform-based and works on touch. No pointer-following.
reducedMotion: The flowing pulse animation is disabled; lines render statically.
